newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chuan Soon Huat in 51.25 mln share Singapore IPO.
newsitem.headline: Chuan Soon Huat in 51.25 mln share Singapore IPO.

text.p: Chuan Soon Huat Industrial Group Ltd (CSH), a maker and distributor of doors, conservatories and joinery products, said on Tuesday it was offering 51.25 million shares at Singapore $0.35 each in its initial public offer.
The company said in a statement that the offer comprises 45 million new shares and 6.25 million vendor shares.
The IPO will raise net proceeds of about S$14.35 million to be used to partially finance the building of a new office block and extension of its factory in Singapore.

It will also be used to partially finance a factory building in China and for working capital in China, purchase of fixed assets, repayment of S$4 million to bankers, and for working capital of the group.
The share offer represents 25 percent of its enlarged share capital and up to 5.125 million shares will be reserved for staff and business associates.
The shares are offered at an estimated price earnings ratio of 12.59 times based on the financial year which ended on December 31, 1996.

For the eight months ended August 31, 1996, the company recorded a net profit of S$2.7 million on a turnover of about S$28 million. For the financial year ending on December 31, the company estimated a net profit of about S$4.5 million on a turnover of about S$44 million.
The share offer closes on January 20 and would trade on a when issue basis on January 22.
